predecessors.name: Han dynasty
predecessors.text: You Province, 'covering present-day northern Hebei, Beijing, Tianjin and Liaoning' (End of the Han page); Liaodong was Gongsun Du's, so Liaoning is left out

successors.name: Yuan Shao
successors.text: You Province, 'covering present-day northern Hebei, Beijing, Tianjin and Liaoning' (End of the Han page); Liaodong was Gongsun Du's, so Liaoning is left out

ledger.x: 193: the war with Yuan Shao over the Qing and Ji frontier.
199: the frontier war ends with Gongsun Zan's death at Yijing (3rd month of Jian'an 4, 14 April to 12 May 199).
199: Gongsun Zan's domain ends with his suicide at Yijing; the infobox gives March 199 for the end of his office, the footnote's Gregorian conversion places the fall in April-May.

wars.name: Yuan Shao-Gongsun Zan war
wars.outcome: Yuan Shao drove Tian Kai out of Qing in 193, besieged Yijing in 199 and annexed You Province.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier for You Province; the shape is a stand-in of modern units.
